title: Python Data Types
learning_outcomes: Explain python data types and accurately refer to at least two syllabus subtopics.
Apply the main idea of python data types to a small example, trace, calculation, or scenario.
Identify one important assumption or failure mode and describe how to check it.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study python data types in the context of python fundamentals for data science. You will connect the PDF subtopics to a small example and practice describing what the evidence does—and does not—support.
content.why_it_matters: Python Data Types matters because it affects how data is collected, represented, analyzed, interpreted, or used in a decision. Check the task and assumptions before choosing a method.

content_blocks.title: The central idea
content_blocks.text: Python is a general-purpose language whose readable syntax and ecosystem support data acquisition, cleaning, analysis, visualization, and modeling.

items.text: Check the edge cases for none: missing values, unusual ranges, different groups, time boundaries, or a changed input can affect the conclusion.

content_blocks.title: Common mistakes and fixes
content_blocks.text: Keep the question, data grain, units, and assumptions explicit. If a result differs, inspect the input and steps in order. Avoid turning an observed association into a causal claim, treating a sample as the population, or assuming a small demonstration guarantees production behavior. A list of dictionaries can represent a tiny table; pandas is more suitable for larger tabular work.
